# SYNESIS_E089 — Error

## Description

Duplicate key `key`: already defined in `a.syn:2`.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The key `key` appears in two project files: `a.syn:2`
  and `b.syn`. Each dataset record needs a unique key
  across the whole project; the compiler used the first occurrence and ignored this one.
  If it is the same item, delete one of the two entries. If they are different
  items, give one of them another key and update the annotations that cite it.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **DuplicateKeyAcrossFiles**: `kind`, `key`, `first_file`, `first_line`, `duplicate_file`
